rubrics.justification: Accurately describes an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with strong ICM, cohesive TE, and thinning zona consistent with 3AA, though some location-specific image details may be overconfident.

Integrates age, PCOS, AMH, oocyte yield, endometrial thickness, prior live birth/failures, BMI, and sperm parameters well, though some links such as estrogen effects and euploid estimate are somewhat simplified.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with a reasonable probability estimate tied to embryo quality and history; minor issues include labeling the case as RIF too strongly and some speculative causal inferences.

Mostly aligned on SET and general embryo assessment, but recommendations for immune/thrombophilia testing and strong PGT-A consideration at age 31 are more controversial and not routinely guideline-supported.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, and further evaluation if failure occurs, though some suggested workup elements are not well-prioritized.
